But I can't make the engine wait longer than 5 seconds in the detection phase. This is also an environment issue (network speed), not a selector issue.

Is this "fundamentally unresolvable"? It's unresolvable in the test environment due to geo-restrictions, not due to the architecture. The rule itself is likely correct.
